finding.query: PDF.js JavaScript library for parsing PDF files client-side
finding.implementation_notes: - Worker path must be configured for Vite - Use `arrayBuffer` for File objects: `getDocument(await file.arrayBuffer())` - Extract text per page using `page.getTextContent()` - Progress tracking: call callback after each page

finding.query: Dexie.js IndexedDB wrapper for state persistence
finding.implementation_notes: - Use compound indexes: `[projectId+type]` for efficient queries - Bulk operations: `bulkPut()`, `bulkAdd()` for batch inserts - Migration pattern: `version(n).stores().upgrade()` - Always mark migrations as applied for idempotency

finding.description: Client-side URL fetching is limited by CORS policy. Many websites block direct fetch requests. Consider implementing a CORS proxy or using server-side fetching for problematic URLs.
finding.implementation_notes: - Test URL accessibility before full implementation - Provide clear error messages when CORS blocks fetch - Consider allowing users to paste HTML content directly as fallback

pattern.name: Dexie Schema Versioning
pattern.description: All database schema changes must use versioned migrations: 1. Increment version number (current is 10, new is 11) 2. Declare new tables in `stores()` method 3. Implement `upgrade()` transaction for data migration if needed 4. Use `isMigrationApplied()` / `markMigrationApplied()` for idempotency 5. Log migration start/completion with `logDexieMigration()`

pattern.name: Event Bus Integration
pattern.description: Use eventemitter3 for progress tracking: 1. Define event types in WorkspaceEvents interface 2. Emit events with structured data: `eventBus.emit('import.started', { sourceId, type })` 3. Components listen via `useWorkspaceEvent()` hook 4. Include timestamps and identifiers in all events

pattern.name: Error Handling
pattern.description: Use custom error classes from error-handling.ts: 1. Create specific error types: `ValidationError`, `ParseError` 2. Include context in error objects 3. Log errors to console with structured data 4. Provide user-friendly error messages via toast notifications

pattern.name: State Persistence
pattern.description: Zustand + Dexie pattern for persistent state: 1. Store records in Dexie for offline access 2. Use live queries with `useLiveQuery()` for reactive UI 3. Compound indexes for efficient queries: `[projectId+type]` 4. Include `createdAt` and `updatedAt` timestamps

note.title: PDF.js Worker Configuration
CORS Issues with URL Fetching
note.description: Client-side URL fetching will fail for many websites due to CORS. Implement graceful degradation: 1. Try fetching directly first 2. On CORS error, suggest user paste content manually 3. Consider offering a CORS proxy endpoint (future enhancement)

note.title: Large File Handling
note.description: 50MB PDF files can take significant time to parse. Ensure: 1. Progress events are emitted frequently (per page) 2. UI remains responsive during parsing 3. User can cancel import if needed 4. Memory usage is monitored (avoid loading entire PDF in memory at once)

note.title: IndexedDB Storage Limits
note.description: Most browsers limit IndexedDB to ~50% of available disk space. Large PDF content may hit limits: 1. Store extracted text only (not binary PDF) 2. Implement storage quota checking 3. Warn user when approaching limits 4. Consider compression for large text content

note.title: i18n Support
note.description: All UI strings must use i18n keys: - `knowledge.sourceImport.progressReading` = "Reading page {page} of {total}..." - `knowledge.sourceImport.errorFileSize` = "File too large (max 50MB)" - Add to both `en.json` and `vi.json`
